narrative.overview:
Every surface is a sticker peeled off a sheet and pressed onto warm paper: a cream card, a firm ink outline, and a solid ink shadow offset down and to the right, as if the sticker is lifted a few millimetres off the page. The world is the same in three places (the Mac app in SwiftUI, the valvd admin page, the GitHub Pages site) and the tokens agree across all three; the Mac app's `Theme.swift` is the origin and both web stylesheets mirror it.

The tone is a cheeky hook delivered in heavy rounded type, then plain facts. Colour is mostly paper and ink; one hot pink carries the action and the asterisk, and four role colours (mint, grape, sun, tomato) tint stops, states and badges. Aster, a pink asterisk with a face, is the one character and appears as wordmark companion, empty-state host and status mood. Density differs by surface: the app and admin page use the light hand (2px outlines, 3-5px shadows); the marketing site uses the heavy hand (3px outlines, 5-9px shadows, slight rotations).
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground with cream cards; dark mode is aubergine paper with cream ink, never pure black.
Ink outlines on every raised surface: 2px in product UI, 3px on the site.
Hard offset ink shadows with zero blur; buttons press into them.
One hot-pink action colour; text sits in ink, never on pink-coloured words except the documented exception.
Heavy rounded type everywhere: SF Rounded in the app, self-hosted Nunito on the web; monospace for file names, ids, ciphertext and code.
Aster the asterisk mascot, with moods.

rules.name: The Words Are Ink Rule
rules.body: Text is ink or soft ink. Role colours are fills, outlines and icons; when a role colour must carry words, use its `-text` sibling (`mint-text`, `amber-text`, `tomato-text`, `grape-text`, `pink-text`), never the fill value.

rules.name: The One Pink Rule
rules.body: Hot pink marks the action and the asterisk. One pink button per view region; secondary actions are cream or quiet.

rules.name: The Always-Dark Ink On Fills Rule
rules.body: Anything drawn on a bright fill (button label, badge glyph, stop icon stroke, Aster's face) uses `on-accent`, not `ink`, so it stays dark when the page goes dark.

rules.name: The Heavy Rounded Rule
rules.body: Headings are 800-900 weight in a rounded face with slightly tight tracking (-0.01 to -0.02em). No serif, no thin weights.

rules.name: The Machine Truth Rule
rules.body: Anything a disk, host or server literally stores (file name, ciphertext name, id, URL, command) is set in monospace; everything a person says is rounded.

rules.name: The Sticker Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows are solid ink, offset equally down and right, zero blur. Hover lifts a site button 2px further (translate -2px, shadow 7px); press drops it onto the page.

dos: **Do** put every raised surface on card cream with an ink outline, and lift it with a solid ink offset shadow (3-5px product, up to 9px on the site).
**Do** use hot pink only for the primary action, the asterisk and Aster; use `pink-text` (#C2185B light, #FF8FB2 dark) when pink must be words.
**Do** use `on-accent` for anything drawn on a bright fill, in both appearances.
**Do** set file names, ids, ciphertext, URLs and commands in monospace.
**Do** ship a dark value for every colour and honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by stopping all animation.
**Do** use the grape 3px outline for keyboard focus.
donts: **Don't** blur a shadow or use ambient, coloured or gradient elevation; depth is ink offset only.
**Don't** set words in a role fill colour (pink, mint, sun, amber, grape, tomato); use the `-text` sibling or ink.
**Don't** use pure black or pure white grounds; paper and ink carry the warmth in both modes.
**Don't** rotate stickers in product UI; tilt is a site-only gesture.
**Don't** load third-party fonts or assets on the admin page; Nunito is self-hosted on the site.
